commits.message:
Exp11 final cells + exp12 phrase-head experiments (C1-C4)

Junk-negative retrain, derive modes (gating fix), comp MLP, same-rows
baseline; exp12: phrases, CLIP_S caching at YOLO rows, phrase/flat heads,
I3D-feature phrase cell, phrase+compMLP combination. Results: mechanism
validated (+1.4 duplex on aligned features, 41/49 rare triplets), encoder
is the bottleneck, combination ties the record — features are the lever.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01XN3X4vdAUpKJHy3BatGrF2

Exp11: YOLO box source + I3D hybrids on the full-candidate protocol

Dataset conversion (verified 3.3M boxes), YOLOv8x ECCV-recipe training
(best=ep1 35.24 agent f-mAP vs 31.6 reference / 17.76 baseline; ep50
29.92 — over-training on 600-scene redundancy), YOLO26x launch (batch-16
deviation, assigner OOM at 24/32), full-candidate dumps (YOLO val/train,
I3D top-300), score-transfer hybrid (action 12.86 / loc 13.36), RoIAlign
head cells (conf-gated λ=0: action 14.92 / loc 18.76; λ=10 duplex 11.19,
action collapse), same-rows I3D baseline + λ sweep in flight.
